ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.rdist.statement: Definition. Let $T$ and $T'$ be measurable spaces and let $G$ be an additive commutative group equipped with a measurable space structure. For a kernel $\kappa$ from $T$ to $G$, a kernel $\eta$ from $T'$ to $G$, a measure $\mu$ on $T$ and a measure $\nu$ on $T'$, the kernel Ruzsa distance $d_k[\kappa;\mu \,\#\, \eta;\nu]$ is a real number. According to its docstring, it is the average Ruzsa distance between the image measures.
